# ConnectLog

ConnectLog is a private, offline-first relationship command OS for QR contact exchange, vCard handoff, local relationship memory, follow-up discipline, bulk contact import, seed pack ingestion, duplicate resolution, and portable exports.

Primary surfaces:
- Landing page: /index.html
- App workspace: /app.html

Data posture:
- Runs as a static PWA.
- Stores app data locally in IndexedDB.
- Requires no account wall or backend to operate.
- Supports JSON, CSV, vCard, and agenda exports.
